Disappointing Service Experience
May 2026 • Couples
I arrived at around 6:00 PM and was told by the receptionist that a table would be available in 5 minutes. I happily waited.

A few minutes later, a Korean family of three arrived without a reservation and was warmly welcomed and attended to. Then, after the 5 minutes had passed, I was informed that the actual wait time for my table would be another 45 minutes.

If the wait was really 45 minutes, why tell me 5 minutes in the first place?

I also tried calling the reservation hotline several times before arriving, but no one answered.

What disappointed me most was the inconsistent and seemingly unfair treatment of customers. For a restaurant with such a strong reputation, I expected much better service.

reviews.review_text:
Leean W
Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam206 contributions
0
Pizzas Still on Point
Feb 2021
I am familiar with most of the Pizza 4 P's but this was my first time to go to the Phu My Hung branch. It was somewhat difficult to find and although I know they have a sign on the main road to point drivers in the right direction , although visible in the daytime, somehow we missed it in the night light. I could see there had been some changes to the menu, the most welcome to me being that their salad now includes tomatoes instead of just a pile of lettuce. Also that a balsamic dressing is now offered instead of their honey dressing and dressing with anchovies. As I dislike honey and fish intensely it was always a bit of a mission to ask for oil and balsamic previously and to ask for tomatoes as well. So I was well pleased with the change when I first saw it on the menu. A friend and I ordered pizzas and also shared one another's as well, and my husband ordered a beef rib from the Seasonal Menu. I was disappointed with my salad when it came, the leaves were the same green leaves, without variation and were very hard and tough to eat. The tomatoes were obviously diced large tomatoes but only the outer skin had been used rather than full chunks with their pips etc. So the tomatoes weren't particularly juicy or satisfying. By way of contrast, the dressing was delicious. That said, I ended up sharing my friend's kale salad which was absolutely wonderful - great texture, delicate salad dressing and liberal use of grated Parmesan over the whole salad. I would definitely order this particular salad next time, it was one of the nicest ever tasted. When the pizzas arrived they were just as delicious as other Pizza 4 P's and we sampled a variety as we had each ordered different halves of pizza. Between us then we very much enjoyed a Margarita pizza, 3 Cheese Pizza, Pizza with Camembert and Ham and a pizza with salami etc. The pizzas were warm as opposed to hot but this is a usual feature of all the Pizza 4 P's, which is a shame, but such is the great taste of the pizza that the temperature doesn't detract from the fabulous flavours. One disappointment of this branch is that they were unable to provide a small dish of salt to use on our pizzas. It is rare for any of their salt grinders in any branch to work, and is a constant source of amusement to our friends . Nevertheless every branch has always managed to provide loose salt in a small bowl from the kitchen. However in the Phu My Hung branch the waiter came back and said that the kitchen didn't have any. As he was a really friendly helpful waiter he came back a few moments later with a small plate of rock salt , which he said he had emptied from the grinder. It was very sweet of him but the lumps were far too large to sprinkle on our pizza and impossible to break with our fingers. Luckily , as my husband's rib had not arrived, using the blade of a knife and sheer strength, he was able to break down the large salt granules into a manageable size. It seems like a fuss over nothing, but to us pizza without salt is like strawberries without cream or bread without butter etc. it was only at the end of the meal that we found out that my husband hadn't enjoyed his at all. At first the beef rib had looked delicious when brought to the table although the accompanying salad was a source of great amusement to us when first seem There was just a huge pile of massive lettuce leaves piled one on top of the other, nothing accompanying the lettuce and no attempt to dice or shred it. At the end of the meal we asked my husband why he hadn't put some dressing on the leaves and cut them up and he said that no dressing had been provided, just a huge pile of dry leaves. I then said well at least he had enjoyed the rib to which he said it was probably the most unpleasant meal he had ever eaten. I was rather taken aback, not because my husband hadn't complained to us because he has that kind of patient , accepting character but because he has nevertheless eaten so much of the rib. He explained that the beef we had seen when it first arrived was just a thin veneer and all of the rest of the huge rib was sheer fat. I asked why he hadn't shown the waiter and maybe they could have changed it for something else but he said that he never likes to complain, but also he has a medical condition where he finds it difficult to gain weight so he had dutifully tried to eat some of it, hoping it might help with any weight gain. I appreciate he should have drawn attention to the rib but each person is different. At the end of the meal a lady clearing away asked if we had enjoyed the meal and we eulogized genuinely about the pizzas but I did tell her about the unpleasant beef rib. She apologised and a few minutes later another lady came over , possibly the supervisor, to ask about the rib so it was very nice that the first lady had taken the matter seriously enough to report it to someone. My husband explained about the beef rib again. This lady also apologised, although of course it was not her fault, and she seemed very genuinely disappointed with the experience. She also said that a few customers had complained about the rib and that it was being taken off the menu the very next day. So, disappointment for my husband, but wonderful pizzas for me and a friend. I find this experience very difficulty tp judge. Because although my husband's beef rib and lettuce was clearly unappetizing, our pizzas were, as with all Pizza 4 P's pizzas, exceptionally delicious and the kale salad was superb. Added to which, all of the staff in this branch were extremely welcoming, helpful and friendly. The score should probably come out as Good overall, if you take into account the tough lettuce leaves in one of the salads as well as the almost completely fat beef rib, but Trip Advisor only allows for an Average or Very Good rating and no Good. I finally decided that because of the sheer taste of the pizzas and kale salad, and the super service from the staff, that the overall majority experience leaned more over to Very Good than Average. I am not sure that my husband will be to keen to go to Pizza 4 P's for a while but me and friends will continue to go for their pizzas, and of course - the kale salad.

Shockingly bad night of service at 4P’s
Feb 2021 • Friends
I have been here many a time and was so disappointed this time round with the service or lack there of. It was terribly busy and they just could not cope. Three people in our party had to change order, because they had run out of food they originally ordered. Came back and said no sorry one person could get same pizza toppings but only 1 of those who ordered it. Wait staff came back again and said nope no more so person had to change food order. 3 persons did not receive their meals at all and when this was checked and rechecked after giving another 30 mins, wait staff said 10 minutes. Again we wait and one meal arrives and 2 do not. Meanwhile a dessert ordered arrives yet still no main meal for 2 persons. Ended up cancelling said order and then I said no to food free of charge as I was not prepared to wait any longer for food the chefs may or may not get around to cooking. We had Vietnamese persons in our party so communication glitches was not the issue. On a good note we did receive drink and food vouchers as an apology for their terrible service. This seems to be a recurring theme here in HCMC when faced with a table of 10 people. Not first restaurant this has happened in for me. Whomever trains hospitality to Vietnamese staff in reputable restaurants should be fired. Get better service at the local Pho restaurant.

Pizza 4P's
Dear Cate71,

I’m Khoa Nguyen- Manager Pizza 4P's Phu My Hung.

Firstly, I would like to thank you for spending your time to give us really honest feedback. This feedback helps us a lot to improve ourselves in the future. We appreciate that.

Then, I am really sorry about our slow service which made you feel disappointed last Monday. This mistake happened because we did not control the situation well and it was really busy that night, which led to the fact that food took really longer than our expectation and affected your feeling. Otherwise, we got so many orders that night and many dishes were out of stock, all of these problems made our service go down which we never expected. Once again, we are sorry for everything.

After that night, I already had a meeting with all the staff to talk about the mistakes and think about how to bring the service back to normal. I will also arrange some courses to train staff how to serve customers professionally and make customers happy even in bad situations. We will try our best to give you and all other customers with the best service in the near future.

After all, I am looking forward to seeing you again in Pizza 4P's Phu My Hung one day.
 
Hope you have a great weekend.

Sincerely,
Khoa Nguyen.
